rule: gate.js notlose, read ONCE at 200 games: PASS iff the Wilson 95% UPPER bound of X's score is >= 0.5 (X is not shown to lose); FAIL otherwise. VOID, whatever the score, if ANY capability bar fails. A PASS is a not-lose screen, not a strength claim.

bars.text: Per arm (solver/mew/play.js ARMS, summed by gate.js `arms`): (1) prior-fallback share = fallback decisions / non-forced decisions <= 0.05; (2) playouts per searched decision >= 161; (3) clock ratio decision_ms.x.mean / decision_ms.y.mean <= 1.10; (4) >= 190 of 200 games scored. Capability, summed over the last line of every shard: (5) Y's strip RAN — ctr.pre169 views > 0, worlds > 0, bodies > 0 (a body can only be stripped if it carried `_sp`, so this also proves the bodies carry it); (6) the true battles' megas recomputed from `_sp` — ctr.form_stats.mega_from_spread > 0. Reported, not bars: mega_delta, mega_stale and the forme pair (process counters: they count the true battles and any full-mode step; lean playouts keep none).
